points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers read correctly, with digits and symbols in the right order?
Are the three groups clearly separated and titled?
Do the rows that open another screen show a chevron, and the toggle rows not?
Are all toggles on the same end of their rows, opposite the label?
Can you tell from each toggle whether it is on or off?
Does the phone number +973 3600 1234 keep its plus sign and order?
Are all the row labels aligned to the same edge?
